copy.title: Top 27 UK Seed-Stage Wealthtech Companies by Total Raised
copy.h1: Top 27 UK Seed-Stage Wealthtech Companies Ranked by Total Raised
copy.metaDescription: Explore the 27 UK seed-stage wealthtech companies ranked by total raised, led by Nevis at £30.3m, with a look at location and team size.
intro: This page ranks 27 UK seed-stage wealthtech companies by total raised. Together they have raised £191m, with a median of £5.2m and a mean of £7.1m.
Nevis ranks first with £30.3m, followed by Januus.io with £27.9m. The top 10 companies are described below so you can see what each one builds.

sections.heading: What the top companies build
paragraphs: The highest-ranked companies use software in different ways. Nevis develops an AI platform for wealth management, while Januus.io develops a cryptowallet-to-identity database that provides ownership data for cryptocurrency assets, wallets and transactions.

Other companies in the top 10 focus on financial advice, investing and pensions. Clove Group develops technology for broadening access to financial advice. Penny develops a mobile app that uses AI to bring a user's different pension pots and transfers together in one place.

sections.heading: Where the wealthtech companies are based
paragraphs: London is home to the largest share of this group. It has 21 of the 27 companies, which is 77.8% of the total, with £154.4m combined. The North West and South West each have 2 companies, and the East Midlands has 1.

sections.heading: Team sizes across the group
paragraphs: The largest group of companies has between 10 and 24 employees, with 13 of the 27 companies, or 48.1%. Those 13 companies have £84.5m combined. The 5 to 9 employee band holds 10 companies, with £86.9m combined.

faq.question: Which UK seed-stage wealthtech company has raised the most?
faq.answer: Nevis ranks first with £30.3m in total raised. Januus.io ranks second with £27.9m.

faq.question: How was this ranking put together?
faq.answer: The companies are ranked by total raised. The dataset covers 27 wealthtech companies, and the lowest value in the ranking is £2m, held by Confidante.

faq.question: How many of these companies have raised at least £10m?
faq.answer: 5 of the 27 companies have at least £10m in total raised. 2 of the 27 have at least £20m.
